properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The secp256k1 npm package (native/JS ECDSA + ECDH on the secp256k1 Koblitz curve) is a declared dependency of both test-fixture projects, pulled in via ethereumjs-util and the web3 stack. This is Ethereum's signing curve — the fixture projects' accounts sign transactions with it. Quantum-vulnerable (Shor), migration target ML-DSA. Dependency declarations only; no call site in the main application — the algorithms ship with the fixture toolchain installs. Changeable here by editing the fixture lo

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey (OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey single-round MD5 KDF, part of the crypto-browserify stack) is a declared dev-dependency of both Ethereum-toolchain test-fixture projects. Weak legacy KDF used to derive keys from passwords; flagged C for single-round MD5. Dependency declaration only — no call site in the application code; reachable through the fixture toolchain's crypto shim. Changeable here via the fixture package.json.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 (the bcrypt-based PBKDF used by OpenBSD/sshpk; requires tweetnacl) is a declared dev-dependency of the truffle Ethereum-toolchain test-fixture project. Note the object's declared algorithm 'bcrypt' is really bcrypt-pbkdf — a KDF variant, not the bcrypt password hash itself; both are classical password-KDFs, low PQ urgency. Dependency declaration only; no call site in the application. Changeable here via the fixture package.json.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: create-ecdh@4.0.4 (crypto-browserify's ECDH module, built on elliptic) is a declared dev-dependency of the truffle Ethereum-toolchain test-fixture project (and dep_scan-matched in buidler). ECDH key agreement is Shor-vulnerable — harvest-now-decrypt-later applies wherever the fixture toolchain uses it (e.g. TLS/SSH inside the toolchain's own deps). Dependency declaration only; no application call site. Changeable here via the fixture package.json.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 (the NaCl library) is a declared dependency of the buidler Ethereum-toolchain test-fixture project; it ships Ed25519 signing among its primitives. Ed25519 is Shor-vulnerable (migration: ML-DSA-65). Dependency declaration only — the library ships with the fixture toolchain install; no call site in the application code. Changeable here via the fixture package.json.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 (NaCl) is a declared dependency of the buidler test-fixture project; it provides X25519 key agreement (crypto_box). X25519 is Shor-vulnerable — harvest-now-decrypt-later class (migration: ML-KEM-768). Dependency declaration only; no application call site. Changeable here via the fixture package.json.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2 (^3.0.3/^3.0.17, plus @types/pbkdf2) is a declared dev-dependency of both Ethereum-toolchain test-fixture projects, part of the crypto-browserify stack (used by the web3/ethereumjs key-derivation paths). PBKDF2 itself is a symmetric HMAC construction — PQ-secure as a KDF; strength depends on the iteration count chosen at call sites that live in the fixture toolchain, not in this repo. Dependency declarations only; no application call site. Changeable here via the fixture package.json.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js (^3.0.x, plus a 2.0.4 pinned under web3-eth-accounts and ethereum-cryptography) is a declared dev-dependency of both Ethereum-toolchain test-fixture projects — this is the memory-hard KDF the web3 stack uses to derive key material from keystores (Web3 Secret Storage). Symmetric construction, strong PQ posture (A-). Dependency declarations only; no application call site. Changeable here via the fixture package.json.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 (NaCl) is a declared dependency of the buidler test-fixture project; its crypto_secretbox/crypto_box provide XSalsa20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption. Symmetric AEAD with 256-bit keys — PQ-secure (A+; Grover only halves a 256-bit key to 128 bits). Dependency declaration only; no application call site. Changeable here via the fixture package.json.

properties.name: pqs:context
